Looking forward to racing for the boys’ Mayors Cup next Wednesday 4/22 at 2PM followed by a JV/Novice scrimmage vs Belmont Hill and Brooks at 3PM. Come and support your CRLS Falcons!

MPSRA State Champions for the fourth year in a row! Overall points trophies to our girls and boys teams and 1V Girls and Boys 4+ trophies. Sooooooo many gold medals for our hard-working crews in a season with too many weather cancellations. Never give up was the theme of this spring.

Thanks to Pat Scott for making this Regatta happen and with meticulous organization and enthusiasm. Thanks to all the volunteers who made our participation possible, especially Carroll whose tireless efforts are very much noticed.

Thanks to our captains for leading us, and to our Coaches for… everything. Kate, Seth, Aleks, Maggie, Bert and the OG Bill. Lane, Bailey, John, Ruth and Mary Kay.

Thanks to @crls_foca and Tom @crlsfalcons for all the support of our program.

In the words of Pat, for some this was their first race. For others, their last. It was important that we went out big, and had fun.

Let’s go Cambridge!
